newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said there would be a debriefing on Commissioner van den Broek's meeting with U.S. State Department Office of Southern European Affairs Director Carey Cavanaugh, UN Special Representative for Cyprus Han Sung-joo, UK Foreign Secretary's Special Representative for Cyprus Sir David Hannay and EU Presidency's Representative Kester Heaslip at 1800/1700 GMT in spokeswoman Lousewies van der Laan's office.
Van der Pas said Commissioner Oreja had designated the National Library of France to be the 1996 winner of the "Mies van der Rohe Pavilion Award for European Architecture".

Spokesman Patrick Child briefed on Monday's ECOFIN Council. He said the Commission judged France and Germany's objectives in the field of public finances and growth previsions contained in their convergence programme to be realistic and credible.

Spokesman Gerry Kiely briefed on the Farm Council that will be held from Monday to Wednesday. He said discussion would focus on the price package and on beef products and beef based products labelling. Kiely said the Commission was not in favour of having a reference to the origin member state on labels.

Van der Pas said there would be an informal General Affairs Council in Apeldoorn, Netherlands, on Saturday and Sunday. He said discussions would focus on EU and NATO enlargement, Turkey-Cyprus and Albania.
Van der Laan said that the parallel made between the Albanian crisis and the former Yougoslavian one was incorrect.

Asked whether the Commission supported Albanian President Sali Berisha, van der Laan said that depite the lack of confidence shown by the Albanian people, Berisha was a democratically elected President, recognized by the International Community.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/220: The National Library of France, the winner for the "Mies van der Rohe Pavilion Award for European Architecture - 1996".
- IP/97/221: Design protection: Commissioner Monti gives qualified welcome to Common Position.
- IP/97/222: EU to express solidarity with Bulgaria.
- IP/97/223: A comprehensive external relations policy in the field of maritime transport.
- Speech/97/70: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy on "the Euro in less than 500 working days".
- Memo/97/26: Calendar of the Commissioners' activities for March 17-21.
